title: Day of Atonement / Scapegoat
anchor_kjv: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
thread: One sin offering took two goats - because forgiveness has two halves: the price paid (the goat slain, its blood behind the veil) and the sin carried away (the live goat driven into the wilderness). The cross is the one act that did both, once for all.
